idea: Show that the defining equation has exactly the two solutions 8 and −14, so S is the finset containing those values. Then evaluate their sum.
proof:
have hS : S = ({8, -14} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have heq := (h₀ x).mp hx
      have hfactor : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by
        nlinarith [heq]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with h | h
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · apply (h₀ 8).mpr
        norm_num
      · apply (h₀ (-14)).mpr
        norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num [Finset.sum_insert, Finset.sum_singleton]
